messages.content: 2015年的國際象棋錦標賽由誰贏得？

function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

difficulty.description: The level of difficulty for the suggested move. Options include 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'.

message.content: 2015 年的國際象棋世界錦標賽（World Chess Championship）由馬格努斯·卡爾森（Magnus Carlsen）贏得，他在紐約對陣維斯萬納·安德森（Viswanathan Anand），最終以 6.5‑4.5 的比分勝出。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "2015年的國際象棋錦標賽由誰贏得？" They want the winner of the 2015 Chess Olympiad? Or maybe the 2015 World Chess Championship? The phrase "國際象棋錦標賽" could refer to the World Chess Championship. In 2015, the World Chess Championship was held in New York, and Magnus Carlsen won against Viswanathan Anand. So answer: Magnus Carlsen. But maybe they refer to the 2015 Chess Olympiad (team event). The 2015 Chess Olympiad was held in Baku, Azerbaijan. The winner was Russia. But the question: "2015年的國際象棋錦標賽由誰贏得？" It's ambiguous. In Chinese, "國際象棋錦標賽" could mean "World Chess Championship". The typical phrase for Olympiad is "國際象棋奧林匹克" or "國際象棋奧運". So likely they mean World Chess Championship. So answer: Magnus Carlsen. Provide answer in Chinese.
